note: Separates the maker from the thing made
Ties a thing to both its maker and its kind

Asks for the kind by what it is FOR — the question the whole system is built around. The explanation names an example where there is one; the clause is optional in the phrase itself, so a kind with no product (a processor, a battery) uses the same wording one clause shorter
Yes or no: does this thing have that type? The distractor is a type it does NOT have
Asks for the WHOLE a kind belongs to. The one question that is about a part and its whole rather than a thing and its kind — „ist Word dasselbe wie MS-Office?“ is not reachable through is_a

Shows the KIND's pictogram and asks what sort of thing it is. The first question here whose subject is a picture rather than a sentence — a layperson recognises a shape long before they can name it, and that is the order this question follows

Shows a PRODUCT's mark and asks what it is. Needs a picture on the product, which is a trademark and has to be supplied — no product carries one yet, so the question simply is not asked until one does
What an abbreviation stands for. Four rows share ONE code branch, differing only in the pool `subject_kind` names — the template mechanism doing what it is for
The same question over protocols
The same question over connectors — the standards a person can hold
The same question over the notions. Here the short form is a separate attribute: the name IS „Top-level domain“ and the abbreviation people meet is TLD
Asked with the ENDING, which is the handle a person actually has. Only a format with exactly one able product may be asked, or the question has several right answers while the generator names one
The same with „bearbeiten“. The narrower one: an editor also opens, so the viewing question accepts more programs than this one
Sorts a format into its kind — the question that turns ten formats into six ideas plus examples

What FAMILY a kind of thing belongs to. Beside `part_of`, which asks what it is a PART of — the two are different relations and a player meets both, because a processor is part of a device and a kind of hardware component at the same time (#7)
Walks the address apart: a TLD is part of a domain, a domain part of a web address. The same shape as `part_of` on ProductType, over a different entity

A ROW and not a commit — the `stands_for` branch already serves four entities and only needs to be told which pool. Which is the whole point of declaring question types as data (§48), and the first time it paid out without a line of code.
Which of four holds the most. The one question `capacity_mb` exists for, and the reason it is a number rather than a string: an order read off „700 MB“ and „4,7 GB“ sorts by the first digit.

The same ordering read from the other end. Its own template rather than a variant of the first, because a question type is what the repetition schedule counts — the two directions ask about different media and must not push each other to the back
Can you write on it again? A yes/no over the property a person meets as a surprise — the RO in CD-ROM has been saying so all along and almost nobody has read it.
Shows the picture and asks what it is. The question this entity was asked for: a person holding a card who does not know it is called an SD card cannot look anything up.

Four statements about one thing, of which 0 to 4 are true — the classic multiple-response pattern, and the first type here whose answer is a SET rather than one option. The count is deliberately NOT shown: naming it invites arithmetic instead of judging each statement, and at 0 or 4 it would be the whole answer.

Not drawable on its own — a sentence shape for `four_claims`. It lives here rather than in code so the wording can be corrected without a commit, which for a teaching system is the difference between a phrasing that gets fixed and one that does not.
A sentence shape for `four_claims`: the ending. The partner is the format whose extension is CLAIMED, so the truth is a comparison of ids and never of strings.
A sentence shape for `four_claims`: which program can open it.
A sentence shape for `four_claims`: which program can CHANGE it. The narrower of the pair, and the distinction most people have never been told.
A sentence shape for `four_claims`: what the abbreviation stands for. Only for formats that carry a long form differing from the short one.
